source.restrictions: bulbapedia-battle-tree (Restrictions > Pokémon Sun and Moon; Special Pokémon list)
source.bp: bulbapedia-battle-tree (Battle Points table); consistent with smogon-guide
source.itemClauseScope: smogon-guide ("the Item Clause applies to the entire team box submitted")
source.levels: smogon-guide ("temporarily downleveled to 50 ... not leveled up to 50")

multiPartners.scoutable: special Trainers you have beaten (not Battle Legends)
multiPartners.partnerTeam: the first two Pokémon the Trainer used in the battle where you beat them
multiPartners.source: serebii-battle-tree ("scout" a Trainer for 10 BP) + smogon-guide (scouting costs 10 BP; the partner uses "the first 2 Pokemon it had in that specific battle")
multiPartners.defaultPartnersNote: App choice: the game starts you with Pokémon Breeder Rada.

betweenBattles.note: Each battle is a fresh battle (facility replicates link-battle rules; consumed items are not lost). Source: smogon-guide.

opponentGeneration.ivs: per-trainer, equal in all six stats (see trainers.json `iv`)

teamPick.rule: Pick roster sets uniformly at random one at a time, rejecting picks that would duplicate a species or a held item, until the team is full.
teamPick.source: smogon-guide ("picks the required amount of Pokemon from its team one by one making sure that the Clauses are respected")
teamPick.approximation: Rule described by the community guide, not taken from disassembled code. Uniform weighting is assumed.

ability.rule: Uniform over the three ability slots [ability1, ability2, hidden]; an empty slot repeats ability1 (so 1 normal + HA = 2/3 normal, 1/3 HA).

gender.approximation: Ratio not documented; app uses the species gender ratio.

streakPrizes.source: bulbapedia-battle-tree (Items table; awarded by the receptionist after a streak ends)
